# ZayPOS

> AI-powered point-of-sale for UK cafés, restaurants and hospitality venues.
> Runs in the browser on hardware you already own, works offline, and is built
> and supported in Britain by Zayn Productions Ltd (Gloucester).

ZayPOS is a UK hospitality POS (till) system: order-taking, integrated card
payments, inventory, and reporting, with AI features (e.g. invoice processing).
14-day free trial (no card), 60-day money-back guarantee, no long-term contract.

Website: https://www.zaypos.co.uk

## Pricing (per till, per month)

- Starter — £29
- Growth — £69
- Complete — £99
Billed monthly or annually; cancel anytime. 14-day free trial on every plan.

- [Features](https://www.zaypos.co.uk/features.html): full platform capability breakdown.
- [Integrations](https://www.zaypos.co.uk/integrations.html): payment and business-tool integrations.
- [Square vs ZayPOS](https://www.zaypos.co.uk/square-vs-zaypos.html): comparison + 24-hour migration.
- [Getting started](https://www.zaypos.co.uk/getting-started.html): setup and onboarding.
- [Contact](https://www.zaypos.co.uk/contact.html): UK support.

## Citable facts

- Product: ZayPOS — UK hospitality point-of-sale
- Company: Zayn Productions Ltd, based in Gloucester, England
- Pricing: Starter £29 / Growth £69 / Complete £99 per till per month
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card · 60-day money-back guarantee
- Contract: none — monthly or annual, cancel anytime
- Offline: keeps taking orders and payments if the internet drops; syncs on reconnect
- Hardware: runs in the browser on any tablet/phone/desktop; ESC/POS receipt printers supported; no hardware bundle required
- Support: UK-based team, typical response within four working hours
- Migration: from Square or another till (24-hour migration)
